concepts.title: BM25
keyPoints: Probabilistic bag-of-words scoring: TF + IDF + length normalization
Saturation: repeated term matches yield diminishing score gains (k1 controls rate)
Length normalization (b) penalizes docs longer than corpus average
Lexical only — misses synonyms, needs matching tokenization at index/query time
Default in Lucene/Elasticsearch; sparse half of hybrid search with dense embeddings

concepts.title: Chunking
keyPoints: Splits documents into segments before embedding/indexing
Sets retrieval grain size: small chunk = precise, large chunk = blurry blend
Naive fixed-size splitting is context-blind — cuts sentences, tables, code mid-structure
Overlap (repeat tail as next head) only mitigates boundary-straddling facts, doesn't fix lost context
Fails silently: confident wrong answers, not errors — validate with retrieval metrics

concepts.title: Embeddings
keyPoints: Dense vector: semantic similarity ≈ cosine proximity, not keyword overlap
Trained via contrastive learning (e.g., InfoNCE) on positive/negative pairs
RAG flow: chunk → embed offline → ANN index (HNSW/IVF-PQ) → embed query, same model → top-k
Query vs. passage need different prefixes (E5/BGE) or recall silently drops
Never compare vectors across model versions — cosine similarity becomes meaningless

concepts.title: RAG Overview
keyPoints: Retrieves external text at inference time to ground generation
Index offline: chunk docs, embed, store in vector DB
Query-time: embed query, similarity/hybrid search top-k, optionally rerank
Generation quality capped by retrieval — bad chunk in top-k → hallucination
Lost-in-the-middle: too many chunks hurts — rerank best first, cap k

concepts.title: GraphRAG
keyPoints: Extract (entity, relation, entity) triples into a knowledge graph at index time
Cluster the graph into hierarchical communities (Leiden/Louvain), LLM summarizes each offline
Global search = map-reduce over community summaries, for corpus-wide/thematic questions
Local search = traverse graph from a matched entity, for entity-centric questions
Gotcha: no win on local fact lookup; unresolved entity aliases fragment communities

concepts.title: HNSW
keyPoints: Graph-based ANN: hierarchical layers — sparse long-range links atop, dense links at layer 0
Search: greedily descend layers to an entry point, then beam search (`ef`) at layer 0
Roughly O(log N) — each layer prunes the search space, like a skip list
Tuned by M, efConstruction, ef — trades off recall vs latency vs memory
Approximate and fails silently: low `ef` drops recall — validate against brute-force recall@k

concepts.title: Hybrid Search
keyPoints: Runs BM25 (lexical) + embeddings (semantic) in parallel, fuses results
BM25 wins exact tokens (IDs, codes, rare nouns); embeddings win paraphrase
Never sum raw scores — BM25 unbounded, cosine bounded, magnitudes not comparable
Default fusion: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), rank-based, no tuning needed
Alt: normalized weighted fusion (min-max + weight α) — needs calibration

concepts.title: Reranking
keyPoints: Second-stage rescoring of top-k candidates from a fast first-stage retriever
Cross-encoder jointly attends over query+document pair, not independent vectors
Bi-encoder retrieves top_k (e.g. 100) cheaply, cross-encoder reorders those to top 5-10
Can't fix recall — only reorders what stage-1 already retrieved
Cost scales linearly with top_k, so unbounded top_k reintroduces latency
